hypothesis: PLSR distinguishes x' = A x from x+ = A x: the same matrix is certified in a time convention exactly when it is stable in that convention (Hurwitz versus Schur), and the two interpretations give different verdicts whenever the stability quadrants differ.
input_data: Diagonal plants diag(-0.5, -0.25), diag(-1.5, -0.25), diag(0.5, 0.25), diag(1.5, 2) with P = I, x = (1, 1)
40 matrices V diag(lambda) V^-1 (PCG64 seed 110), 10 per quadrant: both stable, continuous only, discrete only, neither; eigenvalue margins >= 0.1
A discrete affine plant evaluated with a theta_dot
mathematical_model: Continuous decrease A^T P + P A, resolution 2 gamma n^2 a p + n^3 u |M|; discrete decrease A^T P A - P, resolution n(2 gamma n^2 a^2 p + u p) + n^3 u |M|. Lyapunov: a positive definite solution of the respective equation with Q = I exists iff A is Hurwitz, respectively Schur.
numerical_result: Diagonal plants: {'diag(-0.5, -0.25) continuous': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'diag(-0.5, -0.25) discrete': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'diag(-1.5, -0.25) continuous': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'diag(-1.5, -0.25) discrete': 'NOT_CERTIFIED', 'diag(0.5, 0.25) continuous': 'NOT_CERTIFIED', 'diag(0.5, 0.25) discrete': 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'diag(1.5, 2) continuous': 'NOT_CERTIFIED', 'diag(1.5, 2) discrete': 'NOT_CERTIFIED'}. Family: 0 disagreements with numpy over 40 matrices x 2 conventions (40 solver refusals, 0 outside the documented gates); outcomes differ between conventions for 20 matrices (20 lie in the continuous-only or discrete-only quadrant; 0 per-matrix mismatches). Cross-applied P: 0 of 40 verdicts certify where numpy finds instability. Discrete theta_dot: raises ValueError.
observation_model: PLSR codes with P = I; PLSR solve_lyapunov in each convention and the verdict with the returned P, also cross-applied to the other convention; numpy eigenvalues as the independent stability reference.
